design_issues.screen: Fund Detail — NAV chart window pills
issues: Chart pills on the NAV history chart are 1D/1W/1M/3M/1Y/ALL (6 pills) — but the review spec calls for 7 window pills matching the backend chart endpoint (1M/3M/6M/1Y/3Y/5Y/MAX). Backend supports all 7 windows correctly (verified in supplemental test). The mobile chart currently hides 6M/3Y/5Y/MAX behind the 'ALL' pill and adds 1D/1W (which are not backend windows per the review spec). Consider aligning the pill set with the backend windows so users can drill into 6M / 3Y / 5Y timeframes directly.

design_issues.screen: Admin Mutual Funds Console — tab buttons
issues: Tab buttons (Overview/Funds/Investors/Transactions/SIPs/Providers/Analytics/Settings) share text with sidebar items (Transactions/Settings/Investors etc.) causing selector ambiguity. Adding data-testid like `mf-tab-<name>` on the 8 tab pills would make QA and E2E more robust.

action_items: Optional design: align Fund Detail NAV chart pills with the 7 backend windows (1M/3M/6M/1Y/3Y/5Y/MAX). Not blocking — backend and Historical Returns table already expose all values.
Optional test-hygiene: add `data-testid="mf-tab-<name>"` to the 8 admin MF console tab pills to disambiguate from sidebar entries.
critical_code_review_comments: test_mutual_funds_iter36.py L214-218 (test_redeem_insufficient_units) — accepts 400 OR 500 as valid; ideally redemption should return 400 for business rule failures and reserve 500 for actual server errors. The supplemental KYC-gate test already narrows this: 400 with 'kyc' text is returned when redemption_kyc_required=true (verified good).

Fund detail file /app/frontend/app/mutual-funds/fund/[id].tsx currently uses 1D/1W pills instead of the spec's 1M/3M/6M/1Y/3Y/5Y/MAX — mismatch with backend windows (backend does not have 1D/1W chart windows for MF).
